# Geology.com

> Geology.com is a comprehensive Earth science resource providing news, reference materials, educational content, and interactive tools on rocks, minerals, gemstones, volcanoes, earthquakes, and planetary geology.

The site combines authoritative geological information with interactive maps, expert-authored guides, and current Earth science news. Content is curated by experienced geologists and gemologists to serve both educational and professional audiences interested in geology and natural hazards.

## Key Topics

- Plate Tectonics
- Earthquakes
- Volcanoes
- Minerals & Gemstones
- Earth Science
- Natural Disasters
- Geologic Hazards
- Gold & Metals
- Mineral Identification
- Oil & Gas
- Meteorites
- Landslides
- Tsunamis
- World Geography
- Educational Resources

## Core Resources & News

- [Geology and Earth Science News, Articles, Photos, Maps and More](https://geology.com): Main portal for geology and Earth science news, rocks, minerals, gemstones, energy, volcanoes, earthquakes.
- [Geology News | Earth Science Current Events](https://geology.com/news.shtml): Current geology and Earth science news from around the world.
- [Geology Articles | Earth Science Articles](https://geology.com/articles): Directory of geology and Earth science articles covering wide range of topics.
- [Geology Tools, Supplies, Equipment and Books](https://geology.com/store): Online store for geology equipment, tools, books, supplies and educational materials.

## Minerals & Gemstones

- [Mineral Properties, Photos, Uses and Descriptions](https://geology.com/minerals): Reference database of 80 common rock-forming, ore and gemstone minerals with properties and photos.
- [Gemstones: Facts, photos, and information for over 100 gems](https://geology.com/gemstones): Gemstone encyclopedia by GIA Graduate Gemologist covering 100+ gems with properties and origins.
- [Diamond: The gemstone, the mineral, the super material](https://geology.com/diamond): Comprehensive guide to diamonds covering gemstone properties, mining and industrial applications.

## Geologic Hazards & Natural Disasters

- [Volcanoes and Volcanic Eruptions - Facts and Information](https://geology.com/volcanoes): Comprehensive articles, facts and photos on volcanoes and volcanic activity worldwide.
- [Earthquake Articles, News and Information](https://geology.com/earthquakes): Earthquake articles, maps, plate tectonics and seismic information with USGS data.
- [Geologic Hazards: Volcanoes, Earthquakes, Tsunamis and More](https://geology.com/geologic-hazards): Reference guide to geologic hazards including earthquakes, volcanoes, hurricanes and tsunamis.
- [Landslides, Rockfalls, Mudflows, Debris Flows](https://geology.com/landslides): Information and videos on landslides, rockfalls, mudflows and geological hazards.

## Plate Tectonics & General Geology

- [Plate Tectonics Theory, Diagrams, Boundaries](https://geology.com/plate-tectonics): Plate tectonics articles, diagrams and maps covering boundaries, earthquakes and volcanoes.
- [General Geology | Articles and Information](https://geology.com/general-geology): General geology articles covering minerals, rocks, fossils, plate tectonics and features.

## Energy Resources & Materials

- [Gold Articles: Geology, Mining, Prospecting, History, Tools](https://geology.com/gold): Guide to gold geology, mining, prospecting methods and tools for beginners.
- [Metals: Articles about their properties, geology and use](https://geology.com/metals): Articles on metals including gold, copper, rare earth elements and their properties and uses.
- [Oil and Gas](https://geology.com/oil-and-gas): Information on oil and natural gas drilling, production and energy resources worldwide.

## Maps & Geography

- [US Map Collections for All 50 States](https://geology.com/state-map): US state maps collection covering physical, elevation, river and city maps for all 50 states.
- [World Map: A clickable map of world countries](https://geology.com/world/world-map.shtml): Interactive world map with clickable countries for detailed geographic reference.

## Optional

- [Meteorite Articles and Photos | Iron, Stone, Stony Iron](https://geology.com/meteorite): Meteorite guide with photos covering types, identification, collecting and impact craters.
